findings.current: पिछली बार से सुरक्षित रखा गया। नया कुछ शुरू करने के लिए फ़ील्ड खाली करें।
findings.problem: नया कुछ is not Hindi word order; the indefinite is कुछ नया.
findings.replacement: पिछली बार से सुरक्षित रखा गया। कुछ नया शुरू करने के लिए फ़ील्ड खाली करें।
findings.evidence: No placeholder; the instruction and its purpose are unchanged.

findings.problem: दर्ज किया is a finite transitive perfect ('[it] filed [it]'), so as a metadata fragment it reads as a truncated clause and never attaches the session as the filer — while the sidecar says the fragment marks the session as the one that filed the work. The component renders it AFTER the session name (project-detail.tsx:437-443), so the agent marker is what the sentence needs; दर्ज किया गया alone is not enough either, because it can be read as the session having been filed.
findings.evidence: Composes as '<session name> · द्वारा दर्ज' = 'filed by <session name>'. No placeholder; both words fit the existing meta slot (12 cells).

findings.problem: English separates Removed (a milestone detached, project-detail.tsx:254) from Deleted (a project deleted, project-detail.tsx:278); Hindi renders both हटाया गया. Comprehension survives because the kind noun differs (पड़ाव vs प्रोजेक्ट), so this is parity polish rather than a defect.
findings.evidence: Rendered: '“beta” प्रोजेक्ट हटाया गया।' vs '“beta” प्रोजेक्ट मिटाया गया।'; generator --check exits 0. The second pass proposes the loan डिलीट किया गया instead; मिटाया गया keeps the guide's preference for the settled Hindi word and still distinguishes the destructive action.

findings.problem: The added “ ” around {subject} does not break any arm or the sentence (checked at seven actions × three kinds), but a subject that itself contains double quotes nests them: '"अल्फा" योजना' renders as “"अल्फा" योजना”. Hindi convention for a quotation inside a quotation is single quotes, which the catalogue cannot substitute into user text.
findings.replacement: leave as shipped, or wrap with ‘{subject}’ to keep one level
findings.evidence: Rendered with a quoted subject through the app's formatter.
